content.description: CHARLI3 is a decentralized oracle to the Cardano Network. CHARLI3 is the platform that provides and verifies datainitially focused on blockchain economic valuesfor blockchain applications. CHARLI3 is a firm believer in decentralization and open, safe, and efficient access to accurate information. The contracts and updates will be open to the public. CHARLI3 will utilize blockchain-based rewards for node operators verifying data. Other services exist on the Ethereum network and report being chain-agnostic.
